blocks.prompt: 13. The motion of a robotic arm moving along a straight track is described by the velocity function \(v(t) = 6 + t - t^2\) where \(v(t)\) is in meters per second and \(t\) is the time in seconds, valid for \(0 \le t \le 5\). Find the distance travelled by the arm.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein velocity ka formula diya hai aur distance poocha hai. Yaad rakhein: distance aur displacement alag cheezein hain. Displacement sirf shuru aur aakhir ka farq hai, jabke distance poora chala hua raasta hai.
Diya kya hai? \(v(t) = 6 + t - t^2\), \(0 \le t \le 5\).
Find kya karna hai? Arm ka kul distance.
Rule kaunsa? Kitab ka Note: v-t graph t-axis ke upar area \(A_1\) aur neeche \(A_2\) ho to distance \(= A_1 + A_2\).
Plan: pehle dekhein \(v\) kahan zero hota hai (wahan arm direction badalta hai), phir har hisse ka integral alag nikal kar positive areas jama karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(v(t) = 6 + t - t^2\) m/s, \(0 \le t \le 5\).
Maloom karna: arm ka tay kiya hua kul distance.
Tareeqa: v-t graph ke neeche ka area displacement deta hai. Agar graph kuch hisse mein t-axis ke neeche chala jaye to woh hissa negative ginta hai, yani body wapas ja rahi hai. Distance mein wapas jana bhi raasta hi hai, is liye kitab ka Note kehta hai distance \(= A_1 + A_2\). Pehle woh waqt dhoondhenge jahan velocity ka sign badalta hai, phir har hisse ka integral alag lenge.

v = 0 kahan hai?
\[6 + t - t^2 = 0\]
\[t^2 - t - 6 = 0\]
\[(t - 3)(t + 2) = 0\]
\[t = 3\quad (t = -2\ \text{rejected})\]
Kyun: Arm sirf wahan ruk kar direction badal sakta hai jahan velocity zero ho. Pooray equation ko \(-1\) se multiply kar ke seedha quadratic banaya aur factorize kiya: \(-3 \times 2 = -6\) aur \(-3 + 2 = -1\). \(t = -2\) diye gaye waqt \(0 \le t \le 5\) se bahar hai, is liye chhor diya.

Har hisse mein v ka sign
\[v(0) = 6 > 0,\quad v(4) = -6 < 0\]
Kyun: \(v = -(t - 3)(t + 2)\). \(t = 3\) se pehle velocity positive hai (arm aage ja raha hai), aur \(t = 3\) ke baad negative (arm wapas aa raha hai). Ek ek test value rakh kar dekh liya.
Dhyan dein: Sign check kiye baghair seedha 0 se 5 tak integrate karna sab se aam ghalti hai.

v ka antiderivative
\[F(t) = 6t + \dfrac{t^2}{2} - \dfrac{t^3}{3}\]
\[F(0) = 0,\quad F(3) = \dfrac{27}{2}\]
\[F(5) = \dfrac{5}{6}\]
Kyun: Power rule \(\int t^n\,dt = \frac{t^{n+1}}{n+1}\) har term par lagaya. \(F(3) = 18 + 4.5 - 9 = 13.5\). \(F(5) = 30 + 12.5 - \frac{125}{3}\); sab ko 6 ke denominator par laye: \(\frac{180 + 75 - 250}{6} = \frac{5}{6}\).

Har hisse ka integral
\[\int_0^3 v\,dt = \dfrac{27}{2} - 0 = \dfrac{27}{2}\]
\[\int_3^5 v\,dt = \dfrac{5}{6} - \dfrac{27}{2} = -\dfrac{38}{3}\]
\[A_1 = \dfrac{27}{2},\quad A_2 = \dfrac{38}{3}\]
Kyun: Definite integral \(= F(\text{upar wali limit}) - F(\text{neeche wali limit})\). \(\frac{5}{6} - \frac{81}{6} = -\frac{76}{6} = -\frac{38}{3}\). Doosra integral negative aaya kyunke graph wahan t-axis ke neeche hai; area hamesha positive hota hai, is liye \(A_2 = \frac{38}{3}\) liya.

Kul distance
\[\text{Distance} = \dfrac{27}{2} + \dfrac{38}{3}\]
\[= \dfrac{81 + 76}{6} = \dfrac{157}{6}\]
\[\approx 26.17\ \text{m}\]
Kyun: Distance \(= A_1 + A_2\); dono positive jama kiye. Common denominator 6 liya.

Tasdeeq
\[A_1 - A_2 = \dfrac{81 - 76}{6} = \dfrac{5}{6}\]
\[F(5) - F(0) = \dfrac{5}{6}\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: \(A_1 - A_2\) displacement hai, aur yeh seedhe \(\int_0^5 v\,dt\) se milta hai. Socho: arm 13.5 m aage gaya aur taqreeban 12.67 m wapas aaya, to aakhir mein shuru se sirf 5/6 m door hai; lekin chala woh 26.17 m. Jaise koi dukaan tak ja kar wapas ghar aaye: displacement taqreeban zero, distance poora raasta.
blocks.final_answer: Kul distance \(= \frac{157}{6} \approx 26.17\) m (displacement sirf \(\frac{5}{6}\) m hai).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab Exercise 7.1 ka koi answer print nahi karti, is liye yeh jawab hamara apna hai. Humne isay computer algebra (sympy) se aur ek alag hal kiye gaye solution se alag alag check kiya hai, is liye aap is par bharosa kar sakte hain. Phir bhi apna jawab khud check karne ki aadat zaroor daliye. Aam ghalti: \(\int_0^5 v\,dt = \frac{5}{6}\) m displacement hai, distance nahi; jahan bhi \(v = 0\) ho wahan integral ko tor dein.
